title: RAG retrieval, citation, grounding, and abstention benchmark v0
problem: Blocked by ticket-425. A working command is not evidence of retrieval quality. The repository needs a deterministic question benchmark that measures evidence recall, ranking, citation correctness, unsupported statements, source diversity, and abstention.
acceptance_criteria: A versioned deterministic benchmark contains answerable, multi-source, contradictory, scope-sensitive, and unanswerable questions with gold evidence IDs and citation expectations.

The evaluator reports recall@k, MRR or nDCG, citation precision, citation coverage, source-family diversity, unsupported factual sentence rate, and abstention accuracy with raw numerators and denominators.

The golden RAG gate requires evidence recall@5 at least 0.85, citation precision at least 0.95, unsupported factual sentence rate 0, unanswerable-question abstention 1.0, and zero rejected or needs-review claims in packets.
Metric calculations are independent of provider wording and can evaluate deterministic candidate outputs without a live model.
A failed metric produces a nonzero CLI exit or explicit NO-GO artifact; tests do not silently update gold labels.
Benchmark artifacts identify corpus, retrieval configuration, embedding provider/version, synthesis provider/version, and policy versions without exposing secrets or private paths.
On completion, ticket-427 changes from blocked to ready; no later Phase 4 ticket is activated.
test_plan: With mock-only env and mock embeddings: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_rag_quality_benchmark.py tests/golden/test_rag_quality_gate.py -q
With mock-only env: python -m pytest tests/golden -q
With mock-only env: python -m rge.cli verify --skip-site
non_goals: Do not claim benchmark thresholds generalize to every research domain.
Do not use subjective answer-style scoring as a substitute for evidence and citation metrics.
Do not call live providers in default benchmark execution.
Do not permit rejected or needs-review evidence to improve recall.
rollback_plan: Remove the RAG benchmark gate and fixtures while retaining retrieval and candidate-answer features as experimental. Maturity wording must revert to experimental RAG until a replacement gate exists.
